name: ImagePerturbation_evaluate_moa
description: Evaluate images from any BBBC021-compatible generator with an independently supplied frozen MoA classifier. Returns Accuracy, Macro-F1, Weighted-F1 (0..1), per-class confusion metrics, per-condition metrics and per-image predictions. model_name labels reports only. Does not train classifiers or invoke generation. Native uint8 pixels (128x128 supported with an explicit native Inception profile), no flips or contrast changes; macro-F1 uses the union of true/predicted labels. Calls download nothing.

predictions.description: CSV/JSONL image index: unique sample_id,image_path,condition; batch when matching batches. Relative paths resolve beside the index. Images must already be native uint8 96x96x3 (128x128x3 only under native_inception/smoke profiles) NPY/RGB PNG. Optional SHA256 is verified.

model_name.description: Report label such as CellFlux, IMPA, or a custom model. Never selects evaluator logic or weights.

evaluation_profile.description: BBBC021 protocol intent. Standard/unseen profiles require native 96x96 images and split=test. native_inception explicitly accepts uniform native 96x96 or 128x128 cohorts without external resizing. smoke allows integration subsets. No profile certifies benchmark identity.

output_dir.description: Parent directory for a unique evaluation run, metrics reports, input fingerprints and execution log.

split.description: Exact reference split to select. Reference tables must contain split. No implicit training-row fallback.

python_executable.description: Evaluation environment Python; defaults to the current interpreter. Requires torch, torchvision, torch-fidelity, torchmetrics and scikit-learn.

device.description: Device for frozen Inception features. Cached metrics run on CPU; auto uses CUDA when available.

seed.description: Random seed, including reproducible KID subsets.

cpu_threads.description: PyTorch CPU thread count in the worker.

timeout_seconds.description: Worker timeout. Failed or incomplete reports are returned as errors.

reference_metadata.description: Ground-truth CSV/JSONL with condition,moa,split; sample_id additionally required for sample_id alignment. Predictions never supply ground-truth MoA labels.

evaluator_checkpoint.description: Local frozen CellFlux-compatible MoA evaluator checkpoint containing model_state with Inception parameters and a 2048->512->13 classifier. No generator checkpoint is used.

label_map.description: JSON ordered list of 13 unique MoA class names, or {labels:[...]}, in this evaluator head output order. Required; never guessed from evaluated labels.

join_on.description: Join labels by condition only when every condition has one unambiguous MoA. For sample_id joins use prediction.reference_sample_id when present, otherwise prediction.sample_id.

name: ImagePerturbation_calculate_fid_kid
description: Compute model-independent FID and KID for generated versus real treated BBBC021 images using one explicitly supplied frozen Inception-v3 feature extractor. model_name labels reports only. Supports condition/batch matching and per-condition reports, seeded KID, shared in-memory features and float64 FID covariance arithmetic. Requires at least two images per cohort and adequate KID subset size. No generator imports, image conversion, training or runtime downloads.

predictions.description: CSV/JSONL image index: unique sample_id,image_path,condition; batch when matching batches. Relative paths resolve beside the index. Images must already be native uint8 96x96x3 (128x128x3 only under native_inception/smoke profiles) NPY/RGB PNG. Optional SHA256 is verified.

evaluation_profile.description: BBBC021 protocol intent. Standard/unseen profiles require native 96x96 images and split=test. native_inception explicitly accepts uniform native 96x96 or 128x128 cohorts without external resizing. smoke allows integration subsets. No profile certifies benchmark identity.

output_dir.description: Parent directory for a unique evaluation run, metrics reports, input fingerprints and execution log.

python_executable.description: Evaluation environment Python; defaults to the current interpreter. Requires torch, torchvision, torch-fidelity, torchmetrics and scikit-learn.

device.description: Device for frozen Inception features. Cached metrics run on CPU; auto uses CUDA when available.

seed.description: Random seed, including reproducible KID subsets.

cpu_threads.description: PyTorch CPU thread count in the worker.

timeout_seconds.description: Worker timeout. Failed or incomplete reports are returned as errors.

reference_images.description: Real treated-image CSV/JSONL with sample_id,image_path,condition,split and required match fields. Selected split and prediction condition/batch groups define the reference cohort.

feature_extractor_weights.description: Local torch-fidelity inception-v3-compat state_dict. Must use the same frozen weights and preprocessing for every model compared. No runtime downloads.

match_keys.description: Reference matching fields; must include condition. Default also enforces batch coverage. Extra real groups are excluded and counted.

cohort_balance.description: as_provided keeps the original matched cohorts. match_group_counts uses seeded sampling without replacement to retain the smaller count from each side in every match group.

kid_subset_size.description: KID subset size. Must not exceed either cohort; small tests must explicitly lower it. No silent adjustment.

kid_subsets.description: Number of reproducible KID subset draws. Unbiased KID may be negative.

per_condition.description: Also compute metrics per condition where sample counts meet the configured minimum; otherwise report insufficient_samples.
